elements.name: subscribe
elements.brief:
Subscribe to given message_id(s) and optionally add a hook called immediately on send.
Hook runs synchronously in the sender context (inside Pigeon.send) before msg.post,
and does not run in the receiver script.
elements.description:
Subscribe to given message_id(s) and optionally add a hook called immediately on send.
Hook runs synchronously in the sender context (inside Pigeon.send) before msg.post,
and does not run in the receiver script.

parameters.name: messages
parameters.doc: @Table containing message_id(s) that caller will be subscribed to. Can be a single message as string or hash or a table containing messages as strings or hashes.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: @Optional callback function to be called everytime, when sending subscribed message(s). Uses context parameter.

parameters.name: url
parameters.doc: @Optional URL of the subscriber (v1.3 order).

parameters.name: context
parameters.doc: @Optional context to be passed to the callback function.

parameters.name: is_optimizing
parameters.doc: @If true, skips subscribing to messages already registered for the same url.

returnvalues.doc: @Unique id of the subscription if subscribed succesfully, false otherwise.

elements.name: send
elements.brief:
Send a message of given message_id with given message table to all subscribed subscribers.
Additionally, Pigeon checks in runtime if message is correct if defined.
If the message has a hook attached, it will be called immediately.
elements.description:

Additionally, Pigeon checks in runtime if message is correct if defined.
If the message has a hook attached, it will be called immediately.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.doc: @Defold message_id string or hashed. It will be prehashed anyway.

parameters.name: message
parameters.doc: @Optional definition message table to check before sending.

returnvalues.doc: @True if data is correct and send succesfully, false otherwise.

elements.name: send_to
elements.brief:
Equivalent to Defold built-in `msg.post`. Sends a message of given message_id with an optional data in message table to a specified url.
Accepts the same target forms as `msg.post`: a `url` userdata, a url-like
`string` (e.g. "/gui#hud" or "#fragment"), or a `hash` game object id
(e.g. the id returned by `factory.create` or `go.get_id`).
Additionally, Pigeon checks in runtime if message is correct if defined.
elements.description:
Equivalent to Defold built-in `msg.post`. Sends a message of given message_id with an optional data in message table to a specified url.
Accepts the same target forms as `msg.post`: a `url` userdata, a url-like
`string` (e.g. "/gui#hud" or "#fragment"), or a `hash` game object id
(e.g. the id returned by `factory.create` or `go.get_id`).
Additionally, Pigeon checks in runtime if message is correct if defined.

parameters.name: url
parameters.doc: @Target's url, url-like string, or game object hash id.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.doc: @Defold message_id string or hashed. It will be prehashed anyway.

parameters.name: message
parameters.doc: @Optional message table to check.

returnvalues.doc: @True if data is correct and send succesfully, false otherwise.

elements.name: toggle_logging
elements.brief:
Enable or disable logging functionality.
It only switches between default logging (printing to console) and not logging.
If you want to use dependency logging, you need to set dependency again after enabling logging.
The correctness of arguments is not checked! Use responsibly!
elements.description:
Enable or disable logging functionality.
It only switches between default logging (printing to console) and not logging.
If you want to use dependency logging, you need to set dependency again after enabling logging.
The correctness of arguments is not checked! Use responsibly!

parameters.name: enable
parameters.doc: @Flag to set logging enabled (true) or disabled (false).

elements.name: set_dependency_module_log
elements.brief:
Replace internal printing with logging from Log module.
It is suited for Log API, so if you want to provide your own module, follow the API,
or modify internal Pigeon calls for logging accordingly.
The correctness of arguments is not checked! Use responsibly!

parameters.name: module

parameters.name: tag
parameters.doc: @Optional own string tag to replace the default tag ("pign").

elements.name: set_dependency_module_hashed
elements.deprecated: Pigeon always uses its internal `hashed` module. This function is a no-op kept for backward compatibility.

elements.name: new
elements.brief: Creates a new instance that registers message handlers and subscribes to their messages with an optional tag for logging.
